mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, cover_url, summary, author, view_count, created_at, updated_at FROM articles ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, title, content, cover_url, summary, author, view_count, created_at, updated_at FROM articles WHERE title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR author LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO articles (title, content, cover_url, summary, author, view_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{coverUrl}, #{summary}, #{author}, #{viewCount}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE articles SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, cover_url = #{coverUrl}, summary = #{summary}, author = #{author}, view_count = #{viewCount}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
